#0 Setup
```{r}
library(readr)
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(purrr)

library(ggplot2)
library(forcats)

library(rmcorr)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
```

#1 Read data
```{r}
eye_data <- read_csv("data/eye_tracking_anonymised.csv)
questionnaire_raw <- read_excel("questionnaire.xlsx")
```

#2 Clean questionnaire (ENJ / SD only, reverse-score SD, collapse repeats)
```{r}
questionnaire_clean <- questionnaire_raw %>%
  filter(TOI %in% c("ENJ", "ENJ-1", "ENJ1", "ENJ-2", "ENJ2",
                    "SD",  "SD-1",  "SD1")) %>%
  mutate(
    Last_key_press = as.numeric(Last_key_press),
    TOI = case_when(
      str_detect(TOI, "ENJ") ~ "ENJ",
      str_detect(TOI, "SD")  ~ "SD",
      TRUE ~ TOI
    ),
    Metric = case_when(
      TOI == "ENJ" ~ "Enjoyment",
      TOI == "SD"  ~ "Self-Reported Difficulty",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    # reverse-score SD
    Last_key_press = if_else(Metric == "Self-Reported Difficulty",
                             8 - Last_key_press, Last_key_press),
    Participant = as.factor(Participant)
  ) %>%
  filter(!Participant %in% c(16, 23, 36, 44)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Metric)) %>%
  group_by(Participant, Media, Metric) %>%
  summarise(Last_key_press = mean(Last_key_press, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
```

#3 Clean eye-tracking (SUB AOI only, derive Subtitle_Type/Modality, aggregate)
```{r}
eye_sub <- eye_data %>%
  filter(AOI == "SUB") %>%
  mutate(
    Participant = as.factor(Participant),

    Subtitle_Type = case_when(
      str_detect(Media, "ST")  ~ "ST",
      str_detect(Media, "SDH") ~ "SDH",
      str_detect(Media, "LC")  ~ "AC",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    Modality = case_when(
      str_detect(Media, "^C") ~ "Intralingual",
      str_detect(Media, "^E") ~ "Interlingual",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Subtitle_Type), !is.na(Modality)) %>%
  group_by(Participant, Media, Subtitle_Type, Modality) %>%
  summarise(
    Total_duration_of_fixations   = mean(Total_duration_of_fixations, na.rm = TRUE),
    Average_duration_of_fixations = mean(Average_duration_of_fixations, na.rm = TRUE),
    Number_of_fixations           = mean(Number_of_fixations, na.rm = TRUE),
    Average_pupil_diameter        = mean(Average_pupil_diameter, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

#4 Merge (long) and create wide_data (keeps Subtitle_Type/Modality)
```{r}
merged_long <- left_join(
  eye_sub,
  questionnaire_clean,
  by = c("Participant", "Media")
)

# ide_data 
wide_data <- merged_long %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(Participant, Media, Subtitle_Type, Modality,
                Total_duration_of_fixations, Average_duration_of_fixations,
                Number_of_fixations, Average_pupil_diameter),
    names_from = Metric,
    values_from = Last_key_press
  )

glimpse(wide_data)
```

#5 run_all
```{r}
run_all <- function(wide){

  eye_vars <- c("Total_duration_of_fixations", "Average_duration_of_fixations",
                "Number_of_fixations", "Average_pupil_diameter")
  q_vars   <- c("Self-Reported Difficulty", "Enjoyment")

  wide <- wide %>%
    mutate(across(all_of(c(eye_vars, q_vars)), ~ suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.x))))

  # rmcorr
  rmc_out <- expand_grid(Eye = eye_vars, Q = q_vars) %>%
    pmap_dfr(function(Eye, Q){
      d <- wide %>% select(Participant, all_of(Eye), all_of(Q)) %>% drop_na()
      if(n_distinct(d$Participant) < 5 || nrow(d) < 10) return(tibble())
      res <- rmcorr::rmcorr(participant = Participant,
                            measure1 = d[[2]], measure2 = d[[3]],
                            dataset = d)
      tibble(Eye = Eye, Q = Q, r = res$r,
             CI_low = res$CI[1], CI_high = res$CI[2], p = res$p)
    })

  # LMM
  std <- function(x) as.numeric(scale(x))
  lmm_data <- wide %>%
    mutate(across(all_of(eye_vars), std),
           Difficulty = `Self-Reported Difficulty`) %>%
    drop_na(Enjoyment, Difficulty)

  m_enj  <- lmer(Enjoyment ~ Total_duration_of_fixations + Average_duration_of_fixations +
                   Number_of_fixations + Average_pupil_diameter +
                   (1|Participant), data = lmm_data)

  m_diff <- lmer(Difficulty ~ Total_duration_of_fixations + Average_duration_of_fixations +
                   Number_of_fixations + Average_pupil_diameter +
                   (1|Participant), data = lmm_data)

  list(
    rmcorr   = rmc_out,
    lmm_enj  = summary(m_enj),
    lmm_diff = summary(m_diff)
  )
}
```

```{r}
library(conflicted)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)

conflicts_prefer(lmerTest::lmer)

res <- run_all(wide_data)

res$rmcorr
res$lmm_enj
res$lmm_diff
```

#6 run_by_single_group
```{r}
run_by_single_group <- function(wide, group_var = "Subtitle_Type") {

  eye_vars <- c("Total_duration_of_fixations", "Average_duration_of_fixations",
                "Number_of_fixations", "Average_pupil_diameter")
  q_vars <- c("Self-Reported Difficulty", "Enjoyment")

  if (!group_var %in% names(wide)) {
    stop(sprintf("Column '%s' not found. Available: %s",
                 group_var, paste(names(wide), collapse = ", ")))
  }

  wide <- wide %>%
    mutate(across(all_of(c(eye_vars, q_vars)), ~ suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.x))))

  grouped <- wide %>%
    drop_na(Participant) %>%
    group_by(across(all_of(group_var))) %>%
    group_split()

  result <- map_dfr(grouped, function(df){
    cond <- df %>% select(all_of(group_var)) %>% slice(1)
    if (n_distinct(df$Participant) < 4) return(tibble())

    combs <- expand.grid(Eye = eye_vars, Q = q_vars, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

    map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(combs)), function(i){
      eye <- combs$Eye[i]; q <- combs$Q[i]
      d <- df %>% select(Participant, all_of(eye), all_of(q)) %>% drop_na()
      if (n_distinct(d$Participant) < 4 || nrow(d) < 10) return(tibble())

      res <- tryCatch(
        rmcorr::rmcorr(participant = Participant,
                       measure1 = d[[2]],
                       measure2 = d[[3]],
                       dataset = d),
        error = function(e) NULL
      )
      if (is.null(res)) return(tibble())

      tibble(
        Eye = eye, Q = q,
        r = res$r, CI_low = res$CI[1], CI_high = res$CI[2], p = res$p,
        Group = cond[[1]]
      )
    })
  })

  if (nrow(result) == 0) return(tibble())

  result %>%
    group_by(Q, Group) %>%
    mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p, method = "BH")) %>%
    ungroup()
}
```

```{r}
res_by_subtitle <- run_by_single_group(wide_data, "Subtitle_Type")
res_by_modality <- run_by_single_group(wide_data, "Modality")
```

#7 Forest plot function
```{r}
plot_rmcorr_forest <- function(df, title = "Correlation by group") {

  nice_names <- c(
    Total_duration_of_fixations   = "Total fixation time",
    Average_duration_of_fixations = "Average fixation duration",
    Number_of_fixations           = "Fixation count",
    Average_pupil_diameter        = "Pupil diameter",
    `Self-Reported Difficulty`    = "Difficulty",
    Enjoyment                     = "Enjoyment"
  )

  df <- df %>%
    mutate(
     Eye_lab = dplyr::recode(Eye, !!!nice_names),
      Q_lab   = dplyr::recode(Q,   !!!nice_names),
      Eye_lab = fct_reorder(Eye_lab, r, .fun = function(x) mean(abs(x), na.rm = TRUE)),
      Group   = factor(Group)
    )

  ggplot(df, aes(x = r, y = Eye_lab)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey60") +
    geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = CI_low, xmax = CI_high),
                   height = 0.2, colour = "grey30") +
    geom_point(aes(shape = p_adj < .05),
               size = 2.8, fill = "white", colour = "black") +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = 16, `FALSE` = 1),
                       guide = guide_legend(title = "BH-adjusted p < .05")) +
    facet_grid(Q_lab ~ Group, scales = "free_y", switch = "y") +
    labs(
      title = title,
      subtitle = "Points = r, bars = 95% CI; filled points indicate BH-adjusted p < .05",
      x = "Repeated-measures correlation (r)",
      y = NULL
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      axis.line.x = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.6),
      axis.line.y = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.6),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )
}
```

```{r}
p1 <- plot_rmcorr_forest(res_by_subtitle, title = "Correlation by Subtitle Type")
print(p1)

p2 <- plot_rmcorr_forest(res_by_modality, title = "Correlation by Modality")
print(p2)
```
